name: Fotisy – Bulk Product Price Editor
author: fotisy

sections.description:
Fotisy – Bulk Product Price Editor is a fast, clean, and lightweight WordPress plugin designed to make price editing in WooCommerce effortless.

100% Free — No Upsells, No Pro Version, No Limitations. Every single feature is fully available to all store owners without paying a cent.

Built For Both Simple and Variable Products

Most bulk price editors charge for variable product support or hide it behind a premium license. With this plugin, full variable product & variation support is included out of the box:
* Expand and collapse product variations smoothly via an accordion toggle.
* Modify individual variation prices directly in the table via AJAX.
* Apply a single regular price across all variations of a product with one click.
* Select individual variations for storewide mass bulk operations (percentage or fixed price increases/decreases).
* Automatic parent variable product range recalculation and cache synchronization (WC_Product_Variable::sync).

Instead of opening products one by one, waiting for pages to load, or struggling with complicated bulk-editing interfaces, this plugin gives store owners a direct, dedicated table where regular and sale prices can be changed on the fly via AJAX, alongside a powerful mass bulk price modification engine.

Key Features

  • Mass Bulk Price Operations Engine:
    • Scope Options: Apply to all products in store, products within a specific category, manually selected products, or manually selected variations.
    • Supported Operations:
    • Increase price by percentage (%)
    • Decrease price by percentage (%)
    • Increase price by fixed amount
    • Decrease price by fixed amount
    • Set fixed regular price
    • Set fixed regular and sale prices simultaneously
    • Granular Target Selection: Apply percentage/fixed price updates to regular prices, sale prices, or both.
    • Batch / Chunked AJAX Processing: Smooth progress bar that processes products safely in chunks without hitting server execution timeouts or memory limits.
  • Instant AJAX Inline Updates: Change regular and sale prices for simple products or specific variations directly inside the table without page reloads.
  • Bulk Variation Pricing: Apply a single regular price across all variations of any variable product in one click.
  • Lightning-Fast Product Search: Search any product by title or exact SKU (including variation SKUs).
  • Smart WooCommerce Sync: Automatically clears product transients and synchronizes parent variable product price ranges.
  • Built for Performance: Lightweight assets loaded strictly on the plugin’s admin page to keep your admin dashboard fast.
  • Security & Best Practices: Strict capability checks (manage_woocommerce, edit_post), nonce verification, and full input sanitization/escaping.
  • WooCommerce HPOS Compatible: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the fotisy-bulk-product-price-editor directory to your WordPress /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Bulk Price Editor to start managing your prices.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes! You can update individual variation prices, select specific variations for mass bulk operations, or use the “Apply to all variations” tool.

Can I update prices for an entire category or the whole store?

Yes! The Mass Bulk Price Operations panel lets you select all products in the catalog or any specific category and apply percentage or fixed changes.

Will mass bulk updates timeout on large stores?

No. The plugin uses chunked batch processing via AJAX with a visual progress bar, meaning even stores with thousands of products are processed safely without timing out.

Does this plugin support High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (custom order tables).
